Swiss Army Bench 0.0.41

- **Every new file is named first.** One New file dialog everywhere: pick a type, give it a name, and the app writes
  its starter before the tab opens. With no project open, pick a folder. The list of types follows the project's
  type (a Streamlit project adds a widget and a canvas).
- **Documents.** Markdown opens as a reader: click a block to edit it in place. Markdown, HTML, SVG, Mermaid and
  Vega files have one Preview toggle (Read or Preview, Split, Source). Mermaid diagram starters for six kinds of
  UML, saved as SVG or PNG. A Docs group and starters for a README, a decision record and a data dictionary.
- **Annotate code.** Select code, right-click, Annotate… (Ctrl+Alt+M). Send to agent sends every annotation as one
  task, then clears them. They are never written into the file.
- **The agent can read the screen when it needs to** (`app_screen`): names only, never a value, and never sent
  with every message.
- **Polish.** Home's figure tiles, Settings in one column with a section list, the Canvas landing page, project
  cards, the ERD's header, and a short "Only works on your machine" badge on connection cards.
- **Fixes.** The agent's palette commands and its moves to the Notebooks and Scripts windows work; the rail is
  covered by a dialog's shade; sample tables say "from Sample data"; the deliverable card names its file; the
  editor's right-click menu is readable in the dark theme.
